# IArkWithWithdrawalRequest
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IArkWithWithdrawalRequest.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArkWithSwap](./i-ark-with-swap.md)

**Title:**
IArkWithWithdrawalRequest

Interface for the Ark contract, which manages funds and interacts with Rafts

Used for protocols that require a withdrawal request

Inherits the curator-whitelisted router-swap surface (`withdrawUsingSwap`, `setSlippage`,
`whitelistRouter`, `SwapData`, and the related errors/events) from `IArkWithSwap`,
which itself inherits `IArk`.


## Functions
### sweep

Sweeps all underlying assets from the Ark and boards them to bufferArk

This function is only callable by the keeper

This function is non-reentrant


```solidity
function sweep() external returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweptTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens swept|
|`sweptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the tokens swept|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.

This function is non-reentrant.


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a previously requested withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.

This function is non-reentrant.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external;
```

### withdrawalRequestId

Returns the current withdrawal request id.


```solidity
function withdrawalRequestId() external view returns (uint256 requestId);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|The current withdrawal request id.|


### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the assets in the withdrawal queue.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() external view returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Returns whether a withdrawal claim is required for this Ark.

It's a keeper helper method to check if a claim is required.


```solidity
function isWithdrawalClaimRequired() external view returns (bool required);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`required`|`bool`|Whether a withdrawal claim is required.|


## Events
### WithdrawalRequested
Emitted when a withdrawal is requested.


```solidity
event WithdrawalRequested(uint256 amount, uint256 withdrawalId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset requested for withdrawal.|
|`withdrawalId`|`uint256`|The protocol-specific withdrawal id (0 for protocols without an id).|

### WithdrawalCancelled
Emitted when a previously requested withdrawal is cancelled.


```solidity
event WithdrawalCancelled(uint256 shares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of shares that were returned as a result of the cancellation.|

## Errors
### WithdrawalAlreadyRequested
Error thrown when a withdrawal has already been requested


```solidity
error WithdrawalAlreadyRequested();
```

### NoWithdrawalToClaim
Error thrown when there is no withdrawal request


```solidity
error NoWithdrawalToClaim();
```

### WithdrawalFailed
Error thrown when a withdrawal has failed


```solidity
error WithdrawalFailed();
```
